## Summary

Download marine Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZs) and Marine Ecoregions of the World (MEOW) using the `mregions2` R package.  Save out to analysis resolution (Behrmann 5 km).


## Methods

Using the `mregions2` package, load MEOW polygons, and rasterize out to native AquaX resolution (0.05 degree WGS84) or Behrmann projection at 5 km.  Also save out a csv with MEOW id to information lookup.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(mregions2)
library(sf)
library(here)

base_rast <- rast(ext(-180, 180, -90, 90),
                  resolution = 0.05,
                  crs = 'epsg:4326')
behr_rast <- base_rast |>
    project(y = '+proj=cea +lat_ts=30 +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs', 
            res = 5000)
```

### Download, rasterize, save MEOW

```{r}
meow_dir <- here('_data/mregions_2026')
if(!dir.exists(meow_dir)) dir.create(meow_dir)

meow_sf <- mrp_get('ecoregions') |> 
  mutate(eco_code = as.integer(eco_code))
meow_df <- st_drop_geometry(meow_sf)
write_csv(meow_df, file.path(meow_dir, 'meow_lookup.csv'))
```

Rasterize marine ecoregions by code.  Projecting the shapefile introduces problems - so rasterize then reproject the raster.  Save as `meow_eco_code.tif`

```{r}
meow_f <- here('_data/mregions_2026/meow_eco_code.tif')
if(!file.exists(meow_f)) {
  meow_r <- rasterize(meow_sf, base_rast, field = 'eco_code') |> 
    project(behr_rast)
  writeRaster(meow_r, meow_f)
}
```

The attribute table available via mregions2 is not complete.  Download directly from:

https://hub.arcgis.com/datasets/dc74cc4bb3bd461a9b181ac441f5f5b1_6/about

and save as `meow_lookup_complete.csv`.

### Download continents shapefile

Download from https://hub.arcgis.com/datasets/esri::world-continents/explore?location=-0.001769%2C0.000000%2C1.00
```{r}
continents_gpkg <- here('_data/mregions_2026', 'world_continents.gpkg')
if(!file.exists(continents_gpkg)) stop('go download the geopackage!')
```
